acceptance: Delimited output is SHA-256 identical to bundled dbgen (trailing delimiter removed) for all 8 tables at SF 0.01, 0.1, 1 and 10, at 1 thread and default threads.
Parquet bytes are identical at 1, 4 and default threads on macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64; schema matches benchbox/core/tpch/schema.py through ArrowTypeMapper.
N=3 medians meet the ADR budget: SF 1 <= 3 s delimited / <= 4 s Parquet, SF 10 <= 30 s / <= 40 s, RSS <= 1,536 MiB (SF 1) and <= 2,048 MiB (SF 10).
Independent reviewer reports no Critical/High/Medium finding (or the live review gate passes); the PR is merged to main.
context:
Owner decisions 2026-11-26 (dialog): (1) PyPI: owner sets up Trusted Publishing once; the agent then tags and publishes 0.x releases when a stage merges and BenchBox needs it. (2) Library repo merges require the review bot (theseus review-verdict/review-gate) and essential CI, mirroring BenchBox. (3) SSB and synthetic acceptance by pre-approved objective criteria: exact row counts, zero orphan FKs, per-column null rate, distinct ratio and mean/quantiles within the legacy generator's 5-seed variation, every query returns rows on both engines where legacy did, exact DuckDB/DataFusion agreement; escalate only on failure. (4) Upstream gaps: implement in benchbox-datagen-core on upstream's public API; upstream PRs are contributions, never waited on; no vendoring. (5) Agent may open tpcgen-rs issues/PRs from the BenchBox-dev fork. (6) Add a Windows arm64 wheel; if it passes the gates, Windows arm64 cuts over too. (7) Cutovers pre-approved when every ADR gate passes; misses go to the owner. (8) Parquet corpus re-baseline once, after the TPC cutover, against library Parquet. (9) Retirement: after all cutovers plus one minor release, remove dbgen/dsdgen and legacy Python generators (qgen/dsqgen under adversarial review). (10) Feature batches: A library TPC; B BenchBox integration; C SSB + 8 synthetic in parallel; D cutovers + re-baseline; E Parquet semantics + DuckLake convert in parallel with A; F retirement.

2026-11-27: library PR #3 (feat/tpch-stage) open, CI green, agent review findings (2 Medium, 4 Low) fixed in e0ac44f. dbgen parity at SF 0.01-10 at threads 1/32/default; Parquet thread-invariant; budgets met (SF 1 1.42 s tbl / 1.61 s Parquet, SF 10 6.93 / 7.73 s; RSS <= 1,598 MiB). After PR #4's buffer change TPC-H SF 1 tbl measured 1.54 s / 1,071 MiB. Next: reviewer re-check of the fix commit, then merge under decision (9). Owner decisions 2026-11-27 (dialog): (1) TPC-DS sub-scale: carry the 72-line tpcgen-rs #677 patch (pin tpcdsgen to a BenchBox-dev/tpcgen-rs commit = v4.0.0 + #677), delete own dsgen/ generators, return to crates.io when released. (2) Upstream-gap rule: no divergent fork; a carried patch only if <= ~200 changed lines, submitted upstream, pinned by commit, listed in README with its upstream PR; anything larger goes to the owner with sizes first. (3) TPC-DS refresh sets: keep own code in its own PR, finish SF 100 parity, offer upstream; required before C removal, not before the TPC cutover. (4) Acceptance: a metric passes inside legacy min-max or the 99.9% prediction interval from 5 legacy seeds; boundary quantiles on low-cardinality columns by rank. (5) Empty queries: must return rows on every seed where legacy does on every seed; where legacy is sometimes empty, the library may be empty on no more seeds than legacy. (6) SSB row counts follow the SSB specification (part = 200,000 x floor(1 + log2 SF), date = 2,556). (7) Oracle defects: qgen seed 0 for Q7/Q12 raises a clear error; the 13 nondeterministic dsqgen cases are excluded only with recorded proof and the library is deterministic for them. (8) Licensing: proceed; ship the TPC legal notice in wheels, templates and tpcds.idx stay in BenchBox, record the position in the licensing doc. (9) Until the review gate posts its first verdict, library PRs may merge with green CI plus an independent reviewer agent reporting no Critical/High/Medium findings; afterwards the gate is required. (10) BenchBox native-datagen extra may be developed and CI-tested against wheels built from a pinned library commit; the BenchBox PR adding the extra merges only after the PyPI release exists. (11) Lock-waiter kills: investigate and report only; no kill-policy change.

2026-11-27 review: guardrail 'no fork of tpcgen-rs' now reads 'no divergent fork; carried patches only under the 2026-11-27 rule'. 2026-11-26 decisions (3) and (4) are superseded by 2026-11-27 decisions (1), (2) and (4)-(6).
description:
TPC-H stage of the library (docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md (revised 2026-11-26, PR #4540), decisions 1, 3 and 5). Depend on tpchgen and tpchgen-arrow by exact version. Write delimited rows without the trailing delimiter and Parquet with BenchBox Arrow types, 122,880-row row groups, non-nullable NOT NULL columns and writer identity benchbox-datagen-<major>. Expose both entry points from the PyO3 module.

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
